mapper.sql: id, honor_code, honor_name, honor_scope, recipient_type, description, display_order, honor_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.select: select from basket_honor_category where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_honor_category where honor_code = #{honorCode} and is_delete = 0 limit 1
select from basket_honor_category where is_delete = 0 and honor_status = 1 order by display_order, id
mapper.insert: insert into basket_honor_category ( honor_code, honor_name, honor_scope, recipient_type, description, display_order, honor_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete ) values ( #{honorCode}, #{honorName}, #{honorScope}, #{recipientType}, #{description}, #{displayOrder}, 1, now(), now(), 0 ) on duplicate key update honor_name = values(honor_name), honor_scope = values(honor_scope), recipient_type = values(recipient_type), description = values(description), display_order = values(display_order), honor_status = 1, is_delete = 0, update_time = now()
